author: Jason Stys
summary: Compare exact saved HTTP regression evidence across union cases, including missing execution and changed assertions.
rationale: Prevents an absent or weakened test from being reported as an application-security recovery.
limitations: Comparison covers saved HTTP evidence; matching labels do not prove that test implementations or assertions are equivalent.
Missing execution and changed assertions remain distinct from verified application-security recovery.
It is not a chronology guarantee, latency benchmark or universal application-security assessment.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
